name: print-social-find-your-style-post-suited-man-with-yellow-glass-shards
title: 'Find Your Style & Your Self.' post with a suited man and yellow glassy diagonal shards
whatItIs: A square dark post with a photo of a bearded man in a suit looking down, overlaid with dark and yellow translucent diagonal shards that fragment the image, a white and yellow bold headline and two small text columns.
whatItMeans: Sharp and dynamic; fractured glass shards give a classic portrait a modern edge.
techniques: Fragment the photo with translucent angled shards.
Use yellow as the accent against dark tones.
Keep text in a clear dark area on the left.

vocabulary.definition: Layered shapes that break up an image.
